## Summary
- mark the Autonomous maintenance run as Validated against Bounded Autonomous Remediation

## Review feedback
Addresses feedback from mzagar/wg-workflows-and-process-integration#9 by replacing the “small gate / big gate” terminology with one acceptance gate containing multiple criteria.
